verification.method: scripts/verify/united-kingdom.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100 (all table years), rank 1950/2026/2050/2100, share, growth, change, per day, density, land area
Births, deaths and their margin (306) in 2026; years with more deaths than births (1976, 2020); every projected year from 2027
Net migration 2026 and 2022, share of growth; peak (2072, 76.1 million) and 2100 total
Births peak (1964) and fertility 1964, first year below 2.1 (1973), fertility and median age 2026, urban share
Density ranking among European countries over 10 million and population ranking in Europe (build checks)
Title, meta description, Article headline, FAQ answers in JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 74 of 74 checks match
